content:
Phase 36 implemented on branch phase-36-visual-story (findings: docs/phases/visual-story-portfolio-feed-findings.md; every in-cycle gate recorded there). Docs, media, scripts and tests only — `git diff origin/main -- tagteam/` is 0 lines and the built 3.0.0 wheel's 86 tagteam/ entries have the same file list and sha256 hashes as the 0.12.0 wheel from PyPI.

Delivered: (A) README restructured in the reader's order around four mermaid blocks (① loop flowchart, ② one-cycle stateDiagram with "REQUEST_CHANGES after 10 consecutive stale rounds (auto)", ③ Manual → Watched → Headless → + Cockpit & Hub ladder, ④ headless architecture), cockpit + hub screenshots, reference tail kept, license/link-back paragraph kept; (B) docs/how-tagteam-works.md — every deep paragraph moved verbatim under stable anchors (#loop #cycle #modes #headless #controls #escalations #cockpit #hub #saloon #files) + "Files tagteam writes" table; (C) docs/media/: tagteam-loop/cycle/modes/headless.svg in the Aegis conventions (viewBox 800×260/260/240/260, role=img + aria-label, no external refs, 3–6 KB, node labels class="node" matched to the README mermaid by test), three 1280×800 PNG screenshots from SEEDED projects (scripts/showcase_seed.py: demo-api escalated + brief → Needs you; demo-web owed/stale → Waiting; demo-docs approved → Quiet; hub started with --registry on the seed file), manifest with slots/alt/conventions/recipe/public-safety checklist; (D) docs/showcase.md with the marked numbers block (as-of 2026-08-15 UTC — chosen so this impl cycle's own 08-16 entries cannot stale it; rationale in findings) and a real abridged Phase 35 plan cycle quoted from the tracked JSONL; (E) scripts/showcase_numbers.py `report --as-of [--usage] [--json]` + `export-usage --as-of` (inclusive UTC day, filter-before-strip, per-(phase,type,round,role) attempt ordinal, 13-key schema, sort_keys, exit 2 on mismatch/missing as-of; stale streak = copy of cycle._count_stale_rounds' loop); (F) scripts/upgrade_smoke.py — `<--python> -I -c` helper with cwd in a temp dir outside the repo, identity line (executable/prefix/version/resolved file) + `go` handshake, parent verifies interpreter identity and (with --expect-version) version + file-under-prefix before go, temp registry = exactly one entry, fail-closed registry-global assertion in the helper, existence+sha256 snapshots of the real registry / every real project's managed destinations / project / sentinel, exit 0 no-op / 1 project changed / 2 isolation or identity failure; (G) tests: tests/test_docs_story.py (20: fences/links/anchors, mermaid lint, SVG conventions incl. only the xmlns URL allowed, SVG↔mermaid labels, PNG IHDR/no-text-chunks, CLI coverage, glossary guard, 5-second test), tests/test_showcase_numbers.py (7: fixture methodology incl. ruling/AMEND/in-progress/legacy dedupe/as-of boundary, production stale rule 11→10, export contract with shuffled duplicate attempts + boundary + byte-stability, mismatched as_of → exit 2, committed snapshot safety, byte-compare of the showcase block), tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py (5: isolated no-op with sentinel + real registry byte-identical, project-changed still isolated, real temp venv with a same-named stub package launched from the checkout cwd → not shadowed, wrong version refused before go, default interpreter reports the checkout). Full suite 931 passed / 5 skipped. Bookkeeping: pyproject + CITATION.cff → 3.0.0, roadmap, proposal §5 note.

Gates: mermaid rendered with mermaid@11 in Chrome (4/4, no syntax errors; docs/phases/media/phase-36-mermaid-render-{1,2}.jpg); SVGs dropped into a local copy of aegis.html's flow/tiers/vis slots (phase-36-portfolio-dropin.jpg); screenshot public-safety checklist item by item (token meta-only — 64-char value absent from visible text; no absolute path in visible text; only the 3 seed entries; all round text authored in the seed; PNG chunks); upgrade smoke through the harness only: 0.12.0 wheel in a scratch venv, 0.12.0 setup run in a fresh -I process with patched registry globals + fail-closed assertion, source harness → no-op, sentinel untouched, temp registry one entry, real registry byte-identical (cmp), exit 0; installed-wheel-mode dry run `--python <0.12.0 venv> --expect-version 0.12.0` → identity = the venv's site-packages tagteam, no-op; `--expect-version 3.0.0` → exit 2 before go. Evidence the -I/external-cwd rule matters: the same venv without -I from the checkout cwd imported the checkout's tagteam.

Deviations for you (findings "Deviations"): README 238 lines excl. mermaid vs ≤200 target (reference tail kept verbatim); the shipped cockpit Usage chart's own "r10 auto-escalate" wording (Phase 34 cockpit.js) is left untouched to honor the zero-package-diff contract — proposed 3.0.1 follow-up; harness tests in tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py (not test_docs_story.py) and the stub venv gets the package copied into purelib (--without-pip, no network) instead of pip-installing a built sdist; seed stores the brief path project-relative because the Feed prints it.
